_about: Blue Hour Neon · the money shot: indigo sky with a magenta band, a 60/40 mix of warm and neon/fluorescent windows, sodium lamp pools on every corner, emissive-only bloom. Needs the night build (reloads with ?tod=night).
_tweak: bloom.strength, night.pools, night.dark (share of windows off), sky.nightGlow.
_stack: grade runs before bloom on purpose: on the night build bloom otherwise smears a non-finite scene pixel into a black blob (grade's clamp scrubs it). Keep grade on and first while bloom is on.
